about: An example domain corpus for RouteOfAdministrationGuard, and nothing more. It is NOT one of kmemo's measured corpora: docs/CORPUS.md governs those three, they are blind by construction, and this file was written alongside the guard it grades. It exists to show what a guard author has to supply, which is the half of a compliance measurement kmemo cannot provide for anyone.
